reserveReview.rationale: The saved 2026-09-29 issuer payload reports direct sUSDe debt of $422,722.29957580566, versus $56,003,176.34275359 secured by DOLA-sUSDe LPs and Yearn LP vaults. LP totalDebt remains an undecomposed protocol position without coinId or depType. This illustrative dated composition runs the corrected adapter over the saved issuer payload with the earlier captured live supply of $108,602,244.08936833; these two observations are temporally mixed and are not a synchronized reserve valuation. Runtime percentages remain producer-owned. Existing one-decimal rounding omits DAI dust; no new dust policy is introduced.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: FiRM totalDebt by direct collateral or undecomposed LP identity; 2026-09-29 issuer capture and earlier 2026-09-29 Pharos live circulating-supply capture, normalized with the existing adapter policy
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: 64.3% is undecomposed LP-secured debt and 34.0% is unattributed non-FiRM issuance. No constituent backing shares are inferred from LP debt or names.
